thread:
Alex K: Quick heads-up — planning a staged flip of feature gate `llm_shard_balancer` tomorrow at 11:00 UTC. rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 30m observation windows. Need someone to execute the toggle, smoke checks, and be ready to rollback.
Maria P: I can run the toggle and own the handoff. Are PR + infra changes merged?
Ryan L: PR merged and config pushed to staging. https://git.company/repo/commit/6a1f2e3 — migration is just a config toggle, no schema changes.
Ryan L: Config snippet to apply:```json
{"feature_gate":"llm_shard_balancer","state":"enabled","stages":[{"pct":10,"duration_mins":30},{"pct":50,"duration_mins":30},{"pct":100,"duration_mins":30}],"safe_default":"off"}
```
Maria P: thanks. My plan: 10% at 11:00 -> verify smoke -> 11:30 move to 50% -> verify -> 12:00 move to 100% (est done by 12:30). I'll update the runbook with checks.
Sophia W: Quick Q — does this touch dedicated or private deployments?
Ryan L: No, hosted only. Dedicated pools are opt-in and unaffected.
Jordan (oncall): I'll watch the dashboards 10:45-12:45 UTC. Rollback trigger: if p50 increases >20ms or error rate >0.5% sustained for 5m. I'll post rollback when I see threshold hit.
Maria P: Rollback plan: flip gate back to previous state and run `deploy-config rollback llm_shard_balancer` — can restore within ~3 mins. I'll keep the fallback flag `safe_default` set to `off` during rollout.
Alex K: Ops checklist: 1) owner: @Maria P, 2) smoke tests: generative chat path + KV cache warm path, 3) metrics to watch: p50/p95 latency, kv-cache hit rate, error rate, 4) notify #incidents if thresholds breached.
Maria P: tagging infra folks for quick review @Ryan L, @Jordan (oncall) — any last blockers?
Ryan L: none from me. I've left detailed logs for smoke in the runbook.
Jordan (oncall): added Grafana panels and alert suppressed for non-critical noise during staged windows. I'll post links in the runbook. :thumbsup:
Deploy-Bot: deploy job created: job/rollout-2071234567 queued (CI: passed).
Sophia W: thanks team — I'll confirm product & docs update after 100% flip.
Maria P: proceeding with the 11:00 UTC window. I'll post progress updates in this thread. :rocket:
